function: Hybrid beamforming: a ResNet DNN outputs analog and digital precoders and combiners, adapted online with LoRA fine-tuning as channels change (pp. 2-3).
system: Downlink single-user MIMO-OFDM, BS 64 antennas and 8 RF chains, user 8 antennas and 2 RF chains, 2 streams, 28 GHz, no RIS (p. 4).
method: ResNet-based DNN trained self-supervised with negative AIR loss; pre-training, then online fine-tuning with LoRA low-rank adapters (fine-tuning paradigm) (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL-A/C/D/E at 28 GHz (10,000 pre-training samples) and Sionna ray tracing of Munich (Frauenkirche base station) (pp. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Pre-trained on one CDL profile (CDL-C for Munich), fine-tuned with 128 or 512 samples on another (CDL-A/C/D/E pairs, Munich ray tracing); CDL SNR -5 dB (pp. 4-5).
baselines: No classical beamformer; learned: pre-trained model without fine-tuning, transfer learning with full-model fine-tuning (TL-FMF), MAML, ANIL (pp. 3-5).
metrics: Average achievable information rate (AIR) and its empirical CCDF; relative AIR change for catastrophic forgetting; number of trainable parameters (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Trainable parameters in online fine-tuning: LoRA rank-2/4/8 261k/267k/549k, ANIL 73k, MAML and TL-FMF 4.268M; used as proxy of computational cost (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 2: "we adopt the CDL model, commonly used for simulating scenarios across 0.5 GHz to 100 GHz [16]"; ref. [16] on p. 5 is 3GPP "Rep. TR 138 901".
q2_support: p. 4: "we use a model pre-trained on a CDL-C channel" and "online fine-tuning is performed every 128 steps using the latest 128 channel samples" on the Munich ray-tracing scenario, a channel not used in pre-training.
q3_support: p. 4: "LoRA outperforms all other methods"; the others are the pre-trained model, TL-FMF, MAML and ANIL, all learned, and no non-learned beamformer is compared (Figs. 2-3, pp. 3-4).
q4_support: p. 5: "261k/267k/549k for LoRA rank-2/4/8" trainable parameters, against 4.268M for MAML and TL-FMF.
q5_support: p. 4: "Pre-training is performed on 10,000 samples using a CDL channel [16]"; channels are simulated (Sionna ray tracing and CDL), with no link to code or data and no public dataset or measurement.
notes: Include, area 3 (LoRA online fine-tuning of a learned hybrid beamformer). q3=0 because every baseline is learned (pre-trained, TL-FMF, MAML, ANIL) and no classical hybrid beamformer is compared. q1 met by the CDL profiles of 3GPP TR 38.901 (ref. [16]); the Munich scene uses the open-source Sionna ray tracer (ref. [15]), which is a simulator, not a released dataset, so q5=0.
